# dtcloud_image_versions (Data Source)

Reads the platform's own image catalogue.

This is not the same list as `dtcloud_images`. That one is what the image service holds; this one is the curated set the platform offers, and it is the only place that says which flavors an image may be built on.

The endpoint answers with a map keyed by family, each holding one entry per version. It is flattened into a single list here, sorted by family and then by version, because a map keyed by a value from the platform would reshuffle a plan every time the catalogue gained an entry.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The platform's curated catalogue -- not the same list as dtcloud_images, and
# the only place that says which flavors an image may be built on.
data "dtcloud_image_versions" "ubuntu" {
  type = "ubuntu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `type` (String) Only return entries in this family, e.g. `ubuntu`. Applied by the provider; the endpoint takes no parameters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `versions` (List of Object) Catalogue entries, sorted by family and then by version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `image_type` (String)
- `min_volume_size` (Number)
- `type` (String)
- `valid_flavor_ids` (List of String)
- `version` (String)
